name: Melati
source:
Cocoa is a young Indonesian girl and Yu-Qing's best friend.

Her name is actually Melati, but Yu-Qing gave her nickname Cocoa, because of her skin color. 

Though Cocoa is still young, she has a dream and grand goal.

"No more revenge."

[Edited from [url=http://www.erotes-studio.com/MayJasmine_english/03.html]official website[/url]]
